item.title: Buy rating on RIL shares; brokerage says ‘attractive valuation after decline’
item.description: Reliance Industries (RIL) shares have recently declined due to Middle East tensions and foreign investor selling. However, Motilal Oswal has predicted that the decline in the stock price has been excessive and is available at an attractive valuation. The brokerage recommends buying RIL shares, citing company’s strong business model and potential earnings swell from crude oil benefits and upcoming triggers like a Jio IPO, signaling strong future growth for investors.

item.title: Indian-origin social media influencer Nancy Grewal killed in Canada’s Ontario
item.description: An Indian-origin social media influencer, Nancy Grewal was found dead in Canada’s Ontario. The woman was known for her outspoken views on Khalistani militants and Punjab’s social and political issues. She was reportedly stabbed to death at her home.

item.title: Cancer care with nutrition: How diet can affect head & neck cancer patients
item.description: Adequate protein intake is especially critical in head and neck cancer patients. Protein helps preserve muscle mass, supports wound healing after surgery, improves immunity, and enables better tolerance to chemotherapy and radiotherapy.
